title: CORI Data S3
text: AWS S3 functions provided package : get_s3_object(), list_s3_objects(), list_s3_buckets(), put_s3_object(), put_s3_objects_recursive(), read_s3_object(), write_s3_object(), set_aws_credentials(). Reads (get_s3_object(), list_s3_objects(), read_s3_object()) use local AWS credentials available (env vars ~/.aws/credentials), otherwise fall back temporary, read-credentials CORI credential-vending endpoint — local AWS setup required. Writes (put_s3_object(), put_s3_objects_recursive(), write_s3_object()) list_s3_buckets() always require local credentials, since vended credentials read-. Note: functions moved cori.db package, also part coriverse.

title: Open a DuckDB connection configured for S3 access — connect_to_s3
text: bucket Character. S3 bucket request vended credentials . Required falling back vending endpoint. region Character. AWS region S3 secret. Default: "us-east-1". vending_url Character. URL credential-vending endpoint. used local AWS credentials configured. Defaults "cori.data.vending_url" option, CORI_DATA_VENDING_URL environment variable, deployed CORI endpoint. require_local Logical. TRUE, error immediately local AWS credentials configured instead falling back (read-) vended credentials. Use connections write S3. Default: FALSE. dbdir Character. Path persistent DuckDB database file. Default ":memory:" opens -memory instance, matching prior behavior. Pass file path callers need catalog/temp state persist across script run.

title: Open a DuckDB connection configured for S3 access — connect_to_s3
text: Credentials resolved two ways, order: has_local_aws_credentials() finds credentials environment ~/.aws/credentials, connection uses caller's identity via PROVIDER CREDENTIAL_CHAIN — network round-trip. Otherwise, short-lived read-credentials bucket fetched vending_url installed directly static secret. bucket used vending path, endpoint requires ; ignored local credentials present. Vended credentials read-(across allowlisted cori.data.* buckets), writes connection require local credentials – pass require_local = TRUE fail fast clear message instead getting opaque S3 access-denied error mid-query.

title: Sync S3 objects to a local directory — sync_s3_to_local
text: Downloads objects S3 prefix local directory using aws s3 sync. Uses credential resolution connect_to_s3(): local credentials available, otherwise short-lived vended credentials CORI credential-vending endpoint.

code: sync_s3_to_local(   bucket,   prefix,   local_path,   region = "us-east-1",   vending_url = default_vending_url(),   extra_args = character(0) )

title: Sync S3 objects to a local directory — sync_s3_to_local
text: bucket Character. S3 bucket name (without s3:// prefix). prefix Character. S3 key prefix within bucket (e.g., "nbm_block-D25/state_abbr=NC/"). Include trailing slash directories. local_path Character. Local directory path sync . Created exist. region Character. AWS region bucket. Default: "us-east-1". vending_url Character. URL credential-vending endpoint. used local AWS credentials configured. Defaults "cori.data.vending_url" option, CORI_DATA_VENDING_URL environment variable, deployed CORI endpoint. extra_args Character vector. Additional arguments pass aws s3 sync (e.g., c("--delete", "--quiet")). Default: character(0).

title: Sync S3 objects to a local directory — sync_s3_to_local
text: Invisibly returns exit status aws s3 sync command (0 success). Throws error sync fails.

title: Sync S3 objects to a local directory — sync_s3_to_local
text: vended credentials used, temporarily injected environment variables (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN) duration sync, restored. Requires AWS CLI (aws) installed PATH.
